entries.label: Email automation step: subject and wording
entries.reason: Changes the subject or wording of one step in an email automation. The handler writes only automation_steps. It does not enroll, schedule, send or queue anything.
entries.noSend: Changes the step's wording only. No email is sent or queued now; emails that step sends later use the new wording.

entries.label: Customer text and report preferences
entries.reason: Flips one customer's text and report preference flags. The handler only updates notification_prefs (and creates the default rows if missing). It sends no confirmation and no text. Marketing flags and the billing recipient are not on the list.
entries.noSend: Changes which texts and reports this customer gets later. Nothing is sent now, and no opt-in or opt-out message goes out.

entries.label: Appointment note (staff only)
entries.reason: Saves the staff-facing note on one appointment, as the Schedule screen's note box does. The handler writes only scheduled_services.notes and updated_at.
entries.noSend: Saves the staff note on one visit. The visit's date, time, status and price are not touched, and no reminder or text is sent.

entries.label: Email template: name and description
entries.reason: Renames or re-describes one email template. The other columns are re-saved unchanged by the handler's merge. No send or queue is in the chain; the only write is one UPDATE of email_templates.
entries.noSend: Changes the template's name or description only. No email is sent or queued; the template's status, sender and wording are not touched.

entries.label: Email template preview data: name and sample values
entries.reason: Changes the sample values a template preview renders with. Fixtures are preview data only; nothing reads them at send time. The only writes are UPDATEs of email_template_fixtures.
entries.noSend: Changes preview sample data only. No email is sent, queued or rendered for a customer.

entries.label: Email template draft: subject, preview text and wording
entries.reason: Edits the wording of a draft email template version. An active (live) version is refused by the handler; publishing a draft is a different endpoint that is not on the list. The only write is one UPDATE of email_template_versions.
entries.noSend: Edits a DRAFT version only (the handler refuses an active one). No email is sent or queued, and nothing is published.

entries.label: Product use per service: note
entries.reason: Edits the note on one product-use mapping. The only write is one UPDATE of service_product_usage, and only the notes column is on the allow-list. No price, stock count or catalog row is touched.
entries.noSend: Changes the note on one product-use row. No stock count, price or cost changes, and nothing is sent.

entries.label: Text message template: name and wording
entries.reason: Changes the stored wording of one SMS template. The handler runs the same validator the Templates screen runs. No send, queue, schedule or customer lookup is in the chain; the only write is one UPDATE of sms_templates.
entries.noSend: Changes template wording only. No text is sent or queued now; later texts of this kind use the new wording.

entries.label: Timesheet entry: times, type, notes and reason
entries.reason: Corrects one technician timesheet entry the way the Time Tracking screen does, with a required reason. An approved entry, day or week is refused by the handler. Only time_entries and the day and week summaries are written.
entries.noSend: Changes one time entry and recomputes its day and week totals. No message is sent. An approved week is refused. It does not change a pay rate or run payroll.
